title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 54
paragraphs: So when Aristagoras the Milesian told Cleomenes the Lacedaemonian that the journey up from the sea to the residence of the king was one of three months, he spoke correctly; but if anyone demands a still more exact statement than this, I will give him that also: for we ought to reckon in addition the length of the road from Ephesus to Sardis. I say, then, that the total number of furlongs from the Hellenic sea to Susa (for by that name the city of Memnon is known) is fourteen thousand and forty, since the number of furlongs from Ephesus to Sardis is five hundred and forty; and so the three months' journey is lengthened by three days added.
